newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish stocks to gain bigger share in CESI index.
newsitem.headline: Polish stocks to gain bigger share in CESI index.

text.p: The number of Polish stocks in the Central European Share Index (CESI) will rise while the number of Czech and Hungarian shares will fall when its makeup is changed on May 2, a Warsaw bourse official said on Friday.

Arkadiusz Szymanek, the deputy head of the exchange's information department, told a news conference the changed blue-chip index will comprise 33 Polish stocks instead of current 24 and 12 Czech instead of the present 20 issues.
The Hungarian bourse will lose one stock and will have 10 representatives.
The Slovenian market will remain represented by 10 issues while the number of Slovak shares will increase to eight from present seven.
Szymanek said the total capitalisation of stocks represented in the index amounted now to $23.4 billion. The total market capitalisation of the five exchanges represented by CESI was $33.6 billion.
